items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: So he booked me on a big with her... We played a dance there, and then we played one in Chicago and played one in Milwaukee, and one in Gary, Indiana. That's how I really got tight with Lady

ctx.x: You just wanted to be around that sound.

Yeah. Well, you know, that's where it was at. I know Billie Holiday loved his sound, because every time I'd look up, I'd see here, wherever I'd go. So I know she loved the sound. I guess all the guys really dug it.
Of course, Prez having the kind of ear he had and the kind of ideas he had, definitely was one of the people who led into the so-called new music of Bebop.
